title: Xanadu-mod
description: A rudimentary mod to remind you of school and the time-skip gadget you always wanted
body:
# XANADU_MOD
This is v1 of Xanadu_mod

It revolves around the nostalgic feeling of waking up in the morning and being told to get out of bed otherwise you'll be late for school, being told off when you're out too late and such.

The most prominent feature is the time skip, currently only obtainable in creative, which allows you to skip time to the next day.

NOTE THAT this works only when the item is mounted on an item frame and clicked on with an empty hand. Perfect for home builds when you get up in the morning to stormy weather and just wanna skip past it to the sunny minecraft daytime!
